Perturbación
A small disturbance or deviation in the state, trajectory, or equilibrium of a physical system, typically treated as a corrective term in an analytical approximation.
Physics Context:
  • The Hamiltonian of the anharmonic oscillator can be separated into an exactly solvable term and a weak anharmonic perturbation.
  • Higher-order corrections were evaluated by expanding the wave function in powers of the dimensionless perturbation parameter.
Collocations: perturbation theory, first-order perturbation, gravitational perturbation
